items.job: Repair intake plenum with updated plate or gasket kit
items.note: Add new spark plugs if they are oil-fouled. Cost rises if the catalytic converter is already clogged.

items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured 46RE/47RE unit
items.note: Reman prices assume you return the old unit as a core. A used transmission costs less.

items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor (in the distributor)

items.t: Ticking from broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts and replace gasket
items.note: Price is per side. Cost rises if the manifold is cracked or warped and must be replaced.

items.t: Worn front ball joints and tie rods
items.job: Replace front upper and lower ball joints and tie rod ends
items.note: Covers both sides. Add a wheel alignment afterward.

items.t: Blend door problems cause weak or one-temperature airflow
items.note: If the blend door itself is broken, the dash may have to come out, which costs much more.

items.job: Replace both head gaskets and have the heads checked
items.note: Includes head bolts and resurfacing. Cost rises a lot if a head is cracked or the valve seats dropped.

items.t: Hemi lifter and camshaft wear (Hemi tick)
items.note: Dealer parts sit at the high end. Cost rises a lot if metal debris damaged the rest of the engine.

items.t: Truck can roll out of Park (recall)
items.job: Update software and replace shift interlock if needed
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Power-locking tailgate can open while driving (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.job: Replace EGR cooler and inspect intake manifold
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises if the intake manifold also needs replacing.
Free under the recall for covered VINs. If debris spread, injectors, rails and lines are replaced too, costing far more.

items.t: EcoDiesel crankshaft tone wheel can come apart (recall)
items.job: Engine computer software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbags per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN and book as soon as parts are available.

items.job: Secure battery ground fastener; replace steering gear if needed
items.note: Free under the recalls. One also covers a steering gear fault on a small number of trucks. Check your VIN.

items.job: Adjust or replace tailgate strikers per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.
